admission.justification: The note is composed in the launch module while the line and the reference are produced by the hand-over artifact module; the single promise that both name one locator and digest holds only across both places.

applicability: Every role launch whose recovery note and first message name its hand-over artifact.
conditions: The recovery note and the first-message artifact line name the same locator path and the same SHA-256.
Opening the locator returns the exact frozen hand-over bytes the digest records.
The complete hand-over's JSON sibling and an existing seat's restore keep their own references and behavior.
exclusions: A launch recorded before the locator existed, whose saved message keeps its one-file or sibling-path line.
statement: The recovery note and first-message line name the same locator and SHA-256, and that locator opens the frozen handover bytes.
